definition_en: Time required for a request to travel through the system and return a response.
definition_tr: Bir istegin sistemde islenip yanit olarak geri donmesi icin gecen sure.

definition_en: Amount of work a system can process in a given unit of time.
definition_tr: Bir sistemin belirli bir zamanda isleyebildigi is miktari.

definition_en: Ability of a system to handle increased load by adding resources efficiently.
definition_tr: Sistemin artan yuku kaynak ekleyerek verimli bicimde tasiyabilme yetenegi.

definition_en: Property where repeating the same operation yields the same effect as running it once.
definition_tr: Ayni islemi tekrar etmenin, tek sefer yapilmasiyla ayni etkiyi uretmesi ozelligi.

definition_en: Distributed consistency model where replicas converge to the same state over time.
definition_tr: Dagitik sistemlerde kopyalarin zamanla ayni duruma yakinsadigi tutarlilik modeli.

definition_en: In a distributed system, only two of consistency, availability, and partition tolerance can be fully guaranteed at once.
definition_tr: Dagitik sistemlerde consistency, availability ve partition tolerance ozelliklerinden ayni anda en fazla ikisi tam garanti edilebilir.

definition_en: Pattern that stops repeated calls to a failing dependency to avoid cascading failures.
definition_tr: Basarisiz bir bagimliliga tekrarli cagriyi keserek zincirleme hatalari onleyen desen.

definition_en: Mechanism to control producer speed when consumers cannot keep up.
definition_tr: Tuketici hizina yetisilemediginde uretici hizini kontrol eden mekanizma.

definition_en: Horizontal partitioning of data across multiple database nodes.
definition_tr: Verinin birden fazla veritabani dugumu arasinda yatay olarak bolunmesi.

definition_en: Maintaining copies of data across nodes for availability and read scaling.
definition_tr: Erisilebilirlik ve okuma olceklemesi icin verinin farkli dugumlerde kopyalarini tutma.

definition_en: Data structure strategy used by databases to speed up query execution.
definition_tr: Sorgulari hizlandirmak icin veritabanlarinin kullandigi veri yapisi stratejisi.

definition_en: Transaction guarantees: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.
definition_tr: Transaction garantileri: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.

definition_en: Architectural pattern that separates read and write models for better scaling and clarity.
definition_tr: Okuma ve yazma modellerini ayirarak olcekleme ve netlik saglayan mimari desen.

definition_en: Approach for managing distributed transactions through a series of local transactions and compensations.
definition_tr: Dagitik transactionlari yerel transaction adimlari ve telafi islemleriyle yoneten yaklasim.

definition_en: Process of splitting text into units used by NLP models.
definition_tr: Metni NLP modellerinin kullandigi parcalara ayirma sureci.

definition_en: Dense vector representation of text or objects capturing semantic similarity.
definition_tr: Metin veya nesnelerin anlamsal benzerligini tasiyan yogun vektor temsili.

definition_en: Neural architecture based on attention mechanisms, dominant in modern NLP.
definition_tr: Dikkat mekanizmasina dayali, modern NLP'de baskin sinir agi mimarisi.

definition_en: Mechanism that lets models focus on relevant input parts while processing sequences.
definition_tr: Modelin dizi islerken ilgili girdilere odaklanmasini saglayan mekanizma.

definition_en: Training a pretrained model on task-specific data to adapt behavior.
definition_tr: Onceden egitilmis modeli goreve ozel verilerle yeniden egiterek davranisini uyarlama.

definition_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning method using low-rank adaptation matrices.
definition_tr: Dusuk-rank uyarlama matrisleriyle parametre-verimli fine-tuning yontemi.

definition_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: injecting retrieved knowledge into LLM responses.
definition_tr: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: getirilen bilginin LLM cevabina enjekte edilmesi.

definition_en: Database optimized for storing and searching embeddings by vector similarity.
definition_tr: Embedding verilerini vektor benzerligine gore saklayip aramaya optimize veritabani.

definition_en: Adversarial prompt pattern that attempts to override system instructions.
definition_tr: Sistem talimatlarini gecersiz kilmaya calisan saldirgan prompt deseni.

definition_en: Model behavior where generated output is plausible but factually incorrect.
definition_tr: Modelin makul gorunen fakat gercekte yanlis bilgi uretmesi durumu.

definition_en: Delay between request submission and arrival of the first generated token.
definition_tr: Istek gonderimi ile ilk token'in gelmesi arasindaki gecikme.
